Architectural Services/Consultancy offer
Tuesday, 02 January 2024
2304 Hits
Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram wishes to empanel the architects to provide services for various renovation projects/new construction projects to be carried out during the year. Proposals are invited from reputed architects/firms having registration under architect council and statutory registration under Income tax; Service tax etc. Prior experience of undertaking projects in hospital shall be preferred.
Proposals quoting their consultancy charges along with copies of necessary documents should be submitted to the office of the Secretary, KHS, Sevagram, Dist. Wardha- 442 102 within 21 days i.e. on or before 31st January ’24. The Secretary, KHS reserves the right to reject any or all the offers without assigning any reason.
Secretary, KHS
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
